storageLocation.material: JSON array [canonicalEndpoint, trimmedRegion, trimmedBucket] without whitespace
storageLocation.endpoint: ASCII HTTP(S) origin only; trim surrounding whitespace, lowercase scheme and host, omit default port and optional root slash; reject userinfo, non-root path, query, fragment, backslash, Unicode or percent-encoded hosts; IPv4 must already be dotted decimal without leading zeros and bracketed IPv6 must already be compressed (case-insensitive); ports are decimal 1..65535 without leading zeros
storageLocation.regionAndBucket: Trim surrounding whitespace; ASCII [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*; region 1..128 and bucket 1..255 characters; preserve case
